purpose: Reusable existing-Scenario trio cohort for Scenario Lever and Proposal Flow regression
selection_method: Filter the exact v4/v4.1 contract, retain the latest structurally valid Group per ordered Event signature, cap at 50, then choose three runtime-capable Scenarios while preserving baseline/floor/ceiling and maximizing Parameter-set overlap plus pressure/cell diversity. Existing Proposal history is observed but does not disqualify a reusable Scenario.
